nodes.label: Graphify Workflow
nodes.rationale: Defines graphify's extraction, traversal, update, and export workflow.

nodes.label: Graphify Extraction Specification
nodes.rationale: Requires auditable EXTRACTED, INFERRED, and AMBIGUOUS relationships and deterministic node identifiers.

nodes.label: Graphify Incremental Update
nodes.rationale: Preserves unchanged graph state while replacing changed sources and pruning deleted sources.

nodes.label: Repository Agent Guidance
nodes.rationale: Sets repository-specific testing, development, change-size, pull-request, and graphify operating rules.

nodes.label: Testing Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Prioritizes deterministic behavior-level tests, AAA structure, explicit scenarios, and risk-based failure coverage.

nodes.label: Repository Testing Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Specifies testify assertions, scenario-oriented t.Run tests, public behavior focus, and restrained table tests.
